WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_average
  FROM event_averages
),
filtered_events AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.link_to_event,
    ea.avg_amount,
    oa.overall_average
  FROM event_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.overall_average
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as kept_events_avg
  FROM filtered_events
)
SELECT 
  fe.link_to_event,
  fe.avg_amount,
  fe.avg_amount - fe.overall_average as above_overall,
  fe.avg_amount - ka.kept_events_avg as diff_from_kept_avg
FROM filtered_events fe
CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
